textRuns.value: dq.SubmissionHistory - participation, status, program, submitter, measure, cohort, payload type, and received time.
dq.MeasureReports - reported populations, report type, status, subject, measurement period, and received time.
dq.ProcessingEvents - event status, correlation, latency, and machine-readable error context.

SqlServerName and SqlDatabaseName select Azure SQL. UseSampleData chooses built-in demonstration rows or live SQL data. Source control keeps UseSampleData = true; set it to false only after credentials, managed identity access, and refresh are validated.
Compare weighted reported rates within one measure. Population definitions and whether higher or lower is favorable differ across measures.
Do not treat the reported rate as a cross-measure composite or overall quality score.
This report does not calculate MIPS final score, benchmark points, eligibility, targeted review, or payment adjustment. Those outcomes require additional source data and program rules.
